_README: THIS IS A PLACEHOLDER / TEMPLATE FILE, NOT YOUR REAL RESUME. Copy this file to 'master_resume.json' in this same folder and replace every value with your real, truthful information. The agents in this project treat master_resume.json as ground truth -- they will not invent anything beyond what is written here, so what you put here is exactly (and only) what they will ever claim about you. Note on 'experience[].client': 'company' must always be your real employer/consultancy -- never replace it with a client name. Only set 'client' when this was a consulting/staffing placement (e.g. company: 'Some Consultancy Inc', client: 'End Client Co'); leave it null for a direct employer.
summary: REPLACE: 2-4 sentence professional summary in your own words. Example shape only -- do not keep this text: 'Python developer with a Master's in Computer Science and hands-on experience building backend services, REST APIs, and automation tooling. Comfortable across the stack from FastAPI services to AWS deployment.'

experience.title: REPLACE_WITH_REAL_TITLE
bullets: REPLACE: one real, truthful accomplishment or responsibility from this role.
REPLACE: another real bullet. Keep the achievements/metrics you actually had -- the tailoring agent can only reorder/reword these, never add new ones.

projects.name: REPLACE_WITH_REAL_PROJECT_NAME
projects.description: REPLACE: one-line description of a real project you built.
